checks.name: every content field is one the page shows
every column and cell is drawn
every statement in its section with its status
every statement id is its anchor (and no anchor without one)
every statement shows its title, hypotheses, text and notes
every question card with its title, why and its own statements
every family with its name, summary and its own statements
every grid cell with its status and note, in its family and column
every counterexample with its claim and witness
every open-problem group with its heading, intro and statements
every glossary entry with its term and definition

info: status key 'checked': the page shows its label 'Proved and independently checked' (page.json), the content names it 'Checked'
status key 'open': the page shows its label 'Open problem' (page.json), the content names it 'Open'
status key 'partial': the page shows its label 'Partly established' (page.json), the content names it 'Partial'
status key 'not posed': the page shows its label 'Not yet formulated' (page.json), the content names it 'Not posed'
status key 'refuted form': the page shows its label 'Refuted as first posed' (page.json), the content names it 'Refuted form'
